insights.one_liner: STX Group is an Amsterdam environmental commodities trader and climate finance firm with 500+ staff in 13 countries; its posting mentions visa support.

culture.text: STX trades environmental commodities like carbon credits, renewable energy certificates and biofuels across Europe, the Americas and Asia.
Staff often studied economics, finance or business at the University of Amsterdam, VU Amsterdam, RSM or Utrecht University.
Headquartered in Amsterdam, the group (including Vertis and Marine Olie) has 500+ employees in 13 countries; 573 are on LinkedIn.

open.text: STX Group is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a mid-level compliance role in Amsterdam, needs no Dutch and mentions visa support, but drew about 200 LinkedIn applicants.

growth.text: Founded in 2005, it has been trading for over 20 years and now has 500+ employees in 13 countries.
